name: insta-manager
description: Instagram companion for media downloads, draft reminders, privacy controls, and ad filtering

scripts.postbuild: powershell -Command "Copy-Item manifest.json dist/ -Force; Copy-Item THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt dist/ -Force; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path dist/icons | Out-Null; Copy-Item icons/* dist/icons/ -Force; Copy-Item dist/src/popup/index.html dist/popup.html -Force"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/validate-dist.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
